item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence of technocratic correction through IMF-monitored reforms, FX-rule changes, and anti-inflation responses. I found limited direct evidence of Abiy personally admitting mistakes; most of the correction evidence comes from IMF/finance/NBE reporting rather than explicit self-critique. I found clear rhetorical scapegoating, but not much direct evidence of patronage-based economic policy in 2024 from the sources I checked.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF approves Ethiopia’s homegrown reform package","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr","summary":"The package was built around correcting macroeconomic imbalances, moving to a market-determined exchange rate, tightening monetary policy, reducing monetary financing, restoring debt sustainability, and strengthening governance. That is strong evidence of policy grounded in diagnosis and correction, not just slogans.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6","5B.5"]},{"title":"IMF first review says reforms are advancing well","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-09-27","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/09/27/pr-24348-ethiopia-imf-reaches-agreement-on-the-first-review-of-the-extended-credit-facility","summary":"The IMF said the exchange-rate transition was advancing well, the official-parallel gap had largely closed, and there was little disruption. That suggests the government was tracking outcomes and continuing with a policy sequence that responded to observed effects.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"IMF country report says the authorities made “historic steps” and adjusted policy after feedback","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-10-07","url":"https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/002/2024/318/article-A001-en.xml","summary":"The letter of intent says the new interest-rate framework and market-determined exchange rate were introduced deliberately, that the gap with the parallel market largely disappeared, and that shortages were easing. It also explicitly frames the reform as pushing ahead after the initial changes, which is closer to iterative correction than static ideology.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6","5B.5"]},{"title":"Authorities moved to cushion inflation after the currency float","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-08-01","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/ethiopian-local-authorities-crack-down-on-price-hikes-after-currency-float-3549343","summary":"After the birr float, local authorities closed businesses for price hikes, and the IMF staff report says the federal government imported edible oil and sugar to reduce price pressure. That is evidence of a correction mechanism after an adverse policy shock, not simple denial.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6","5B.5"]},{"title":"Abiy’s public framing was slogan-heavy and partly evasive","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-08-01","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4896385","summary":"Abiy described the reform as something to be understood “holistically,” tied it to “Medemer,” and said law enforcement would act against “malicious traders” manipulating prices. This shows a rhetorical style that leans on slogans and scapegoating of traders rather than open acknowledgment of policy errors.","question_ids":["5B.7"]},{"title":"Abiy blamed foreign embassies for black-market FX activity","publisher":"Anadolu Agency","date":"2024-10-31","url":"https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/ethiopian-premier-accuses-foreign-embassies-of-robbing-resources-though-black-market-operations/3380816","summary":"Abiy accused foreign embassies of running black-market foreign-exchange operations and “robbing” Ethiopia’s resources. That is clear scapegoating language, even if the underlying black-market problem was real.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.5"]},{"title":"Abiy defended the currency float as a necessity, not a devaluation","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-08-02","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ethiopia-s-PM-defends-currency-float-amid-inflation-concerns-47541564/","summary":"He said the move was meant to close the official/black-market gap and “was wrong” to call it devaluation. This is not a clean admission of error; it is more a defensive reframing, though it does show the government trying to justify the policy with operational logic.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6"]}]}
